title: Mo Xiansheng Appears Unexpectedly
next_chapter_hook: The shadow of imperial court forces has silently enveloped the Tianqing Sect. Is Mo Xiansheng's prophecy a blessing or a deeper game of chess? And that jade slip recording crucial intelligence awaits the moment of being opened.

text.content: The jade slip's radiance suddenly surged like a giant beast awakening from a thousand-year slumber. A ghostly blue soul flame erupted from the slip, coalescing before the horrified witnesses into a blurry humanoid form—an elder's remnant soul. Though stripped of his former complete spirit, an unsettling pressure like a tide of intimidation radiated outward. 'I am Mo Xiansheng. Entrusted by an old friend, I have come today to settle a karmic debt.' The remnant soul's voice echoed through the great hall, each word carrying immense weight. The informant's face turned ashen as he stumbled backward three steps, nearly dropping the evidence in his hands.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan abruptly rose from the main seat, his aged eyes flickering with disbelief. 'Mo Xiansheng? Impossible! You should have dissipated a century ago!' His voice trembled with shock, fingers white-knuckled on the armrest. The surrounding sect elders exchanged whispered glances, and the entire hall erupted in uproar. Mo Xiansheng's name had become nearly forbidden in the cultivation world—a legend of one who could peer into heavenly secrets.

The remnant soul slowly turned toward Ling Yuan, its ethereal eyes glinting with a hint of amusement. 'Why such panic, Sect Leader Ling? Though I remain but a fragment of a soul, I have not forgotten my ancient vow.' He gently gestured toward Chen Ji. 'Today I come to fulfill that promise— whoever possesses the Tianji Record, I, Mo Xiansheng, shall protect with my life.' The hall erupted once more, and every gaze fell upon that perpetually silent废物 disciple.

Chen Ji stood in place, his face wearing its usual expression of bewilderment and timidity. His lips quivered slightly, as if frightened by this sudden upheaval. 'Mo...Mo Xiansheng? The junior has never heard this name...' His voice was soft, carrying perfectly calibrated confusion and fear. Yet in an angle unseen by others, a subtle gleam flickered in the depths of his gaze—this old codger truly believed he'd catch me off guard.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's appearance has completely broken the deadlock. Everyone awaits how events will unfold. As Chen Ji, how do you plan to respond to this sudden 'protection'?

choices.text: Continue feigning ignorance and observe the situation
choices.description: Maintain the废物 persona unchanged, letting Mo Xiansheng shield you from visible attacks and hidden daggers, and proceed by leveraging his momentum.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Mo Xiansheng's protection, and rightfully escape the predicament
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's true intentions are unclear; blindly relying on him may harbor hidden dangers

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, appearing too terrified to speak further as if scared witless. His silence, to outsiders, merely seemed the usual cowardice of a废物 disciple. Yet the informant's face turned ashen— with Mo Xiansheng as this mighty backing, all his evidence had become worthless paper. 'Continue playing your mute then.' Chen Ji thought coldly in his heart, 'Old Mo arrived at precisely the right moment. Let's see what performance you will put on next.'

choices.description: In the identity of an innocent victim, seek help from Mo Xiansheng, testing how far he is willing to go for you.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence about Mo Xiansheng's layout
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao has been observing you; excessive performance may arouse her suspicion

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised his head timidly, his voice slightly trembling: 'Mo...Mo Xiansheng, you said you would protect my safety, but the junior is merely an insignificant Servant Disciple of the Tianqing Sect. How could I possibly deserve such a great kindness?' His eyes were full of panic and confusion, yet hidden within his words was a blade— if Mo Xiansheng truly intends to protect him, he should show some sincerity.

choices.text: Seize the opportunity to counterattack the informant
choices.description: Leverage Mo Xiansheng's appearance to expose the informant's conspiracy and substantiate the other party's frame-up crime.
choices.visible_cost: Too many enemies made; may attract more powerful foes
choices.visible_reward: Completely clear suspicion while deterring the wicked
choices.risk_hint: The informant's behind-the-scenes forces are unclear; acting hastily may alert the prey

text.content: Chen Ji's eye sockets suddenly reddened, his voice carrying grievance and fury: 'The junior has never stolen anything! This so-called evidence is clearly planted by someone with malicious intent!' He pointed at the informant, and though his fingers trembled, a sharp gleam flashed in his eyes. The informant, intimidated by Chen Ji's momentum, was actually speechless for a moment. Mo Xiansheng's appearance let Chen Ji stand up straight before everyone for the first time. 'The good show has just begun.' He sneered in his heart.

The atmosphere in the main hall turned bizarre. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul floated in mid-air, surrounded by faint soul flames that made him appear like a descended deity. Ling Yuan's expression was so dark it seemed to drip with ink, yet he dared not erupt publicly—though Mo Xiansheng was merely a remnant soul, the forces he represented were far beyond what the Tianqing Sect could provoke. Moreover, the other party seemed to hold some fatal leverage. "Mo Xiansheng," Ling Yuan suppressed the fire in his heart, keeping his voice as calm as possible, "this is an internal matter of our Tianqing Sect. As an outsider, surely you should not interfere?"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng let out a low, mocking laugh, laced with an indefinable mockery. "Ling Sect Master, you are mistaken. The Tianji Record is an ancient supreme treasure, concerning the rise and fall of the world's qi and fortune—how can it be considered a private matter of your sect alone?" He slowly surveyed his surroundings, his gaze finally settling on that always-bowheaded废物 disciple. "Today, the old man will make this clear—this person, I shall protect. Whoever dares to touch him will be making an enemy of Mo."

A flash of vicious light crossed Ling Yuan's eyes, but he quickly concealed it. He drew a deep breath, and his face reassembled that benevolent smile. "Since Mo Xiansheng values this disciple of our Tianqing Sect so highly, the old man cannot very well refuse your face." His tone softened, as if the earlier threat had never occurred. "Chen Ji, withdraw for now. This matter... will be discussed later." Chen Ji respectfully bowed and turned to walk out of the hall.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan suddenly changed his attitude, seemingly willing to let the matter rest, but there must be something suspicious in this. How should you respond to this sudden "leniency"?

choices.text: Comply and exit gracefully, without lingering
choices.description: Accept the situation and not give Ling Yuan any excuse to make a scene—leave this vortex of trouble first.
choices.visible_cost: Missing the chance to expose the conspiracy publicly
choices.visible_reward: Preserving oneself and letting the enemy's scheme temporarily run aground
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might set a bigger trap when you lower your guard

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, walking unsteadily out of the main hall, as if today's events had scared him witless. The whispers of surrounding disciples reached his ears, yet stirred no emotion in him. "Let you enjoy these few days." He thought silently in his heart. "Old Ling, you think letting me go like this can spare you? Mo Xiansheng's arrival is merely the first move."

choices.text: Give Ling Yuan a hint before leaving
choices.description: Deliberately show Ling Yuan a meaningful smile, letting him know you're not truly a废物.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke deeper wariness and hostility from Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Planting a seed of fear in the enemy's heart, laying groundwork for a comeback
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is an old fox—your hint may be seen through by others

text.content: The moment he stepped across the threshold, Chen Ji slightly tilted his head, casting a meaningful glance toward Ling Yuan. That gaze held none of the timidity a废物 should have; instead, it carried a composure that seemed to see through everything. Ling Yuan caught that glance, his pupils contracting sharply. He stared fixedly at the thin figure's back, an unprecedented chill rising in his heart. This废物—far from being so simple on the surface! "Investigate! Thoroughly investigate this person's background!" Ling Yuan roared in his heart.

choices.text: Request a private conversation with Mo Xiansheng
choices.description: Since Mo Xiansheng appeared so boldly, why not take the opportunity to establish a deeper connection with him before everyone?
choices.visible_cost: May expose that you have prior contact with Mo Xiansheng
choices.visible_reward: Obtain first-hand information about the imperial dynasty's intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao has been secretly observing your every move

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stopped, turning to face Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, respectfully performing a deep bow. "Mo Xiansheng, the junior ventures to inquire—what does the 'old friend's entrustment' you mentioned refer to...?" His voice carried apt curiosity and anxiety, as if genuinely seeking to understand the matter's origins. Mo Xiansheng gazed deeply at him, a meaningful smile appearing at the corner of his lips. "This place is unsuitable for speaking. Tonight at midnight, the Rear Mountain Forbidden Grounds—you and I shall converse privately."

text.content: The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the main hall, he felt a sharp gaze like a blade at his back. Without turning, he knew it was Su Qingyao. This woman had been observing him from start to finish—Mo Xiansheng's appearance today must have deepened her suspicions. "Interesting." Chen Ji thought in his heart. "Three times approaching the truth, three times resolved... Su Qingyao, you truly are persistent. But that's good too—some matters will sooner or later require you to share the burden." He deliberately slowed his pace, as if waiting for something.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao quickly caught up to Chen Ji, grabbing his sleeve. "Chen Ji, stop right there!" Her voice carried suppressed anger and confusion. "Why did Mo Xiansheng appear suddenly? How many things are you still hiding from the sect?" Her eyes were like two sharp swords, piercing directly into Chen Ji's eyes, as if wanting to see through all his secrets. Chen Ji turned his head, wearing an innocent expression. "Senior Sister Su, I really don't know what happened..." His voice was soft, yet carried an unignorable firmness. "But I know—in the coming days, the sect is about to change dramatically."

text.content: Night fell, and the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds were shrouded in an eerie silence. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul arrived as promised, his form flickering in the moonlight as if it might dissipate at any moment. Chen Ji was already waiting there, his black clothes fluttering in the night wind. His face no longer wore that cowardly, ignorant look from daytime—instead, a coldness近乎残酷的深邃 filled his features. "Mo Xiansheng," he spoke, his voice calm as still water, "your bold appearance today was surely not simply to help me out of a predicament?"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng let out a low chuckle, his remnant soul's outline appearing even more solid than in the daytime. "You boy, you truly haven't disappointed this old man." His voice carried a hint of satisfaction. "Indeed, I appeared today for other important matters." He waved his hand, and a jade slip gleaming with a faint ghostly light appeared凭空 before Chen Ji. "This is news from the imperial court. Three days later, the imperial court's special envoy will personally visit the Tianqing Sect, ostensibly for an inspection, but in reality..." He paused, a solemn flicker passing through his eyes. "They are searching for the holder of the Tianji Record."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, while in his heart, monstrous waves raged. The involvement of imperial court forces meant the situation had far exceeded his original estimations. What had originally been merely internal sect strife had now evolved into a grand chess game affecting the entire world. He drew a deep breath, reaching out to accept the jade slip, its touch ice-cold. "The imperial court..." he murmured, "It seems the legacy left by that good master of mine is even more troublesome than I imagined." He raised his head, his gaze burning as he looked at Mo Xiansheng. "Sir, you said you would protect me. But with the current situation, can you truly protect me?"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rippled slightly, emitting a profound sigh. "This old man is merely a wisp of remnant soul. I can protect you for a time, but not for a lifetime." His voice grew lower. "However, this old man can tell you one thing—the imperial court's dispatch of people this time was by no means coincidental. Behind them stands..." His words suddenly stopped, a flicker of wariness passing through his ethereal eyes. "Forget it, the timing isn't right. Knowing too much will only bring you disaster. This jade slip contains all the intelligence about the imperial court's mission, and... an opportunity that could change the entire situation."

text.content: Chen Ji tightly gripped the jade slip, his mind rapidly calculating the pros and cons. Mo Xiansheng's words had been pointed yet sufficient, already revealing enough information. The imperial court, Mo Xiansheng, the Tianji Record... behind all of this, it seemed an invisible hand was controlling everything. And he himself, from start to finish, might have been nothing more than a chess piece in this game, unable to act of his own will. "I understand." He spoke, his voice carrying a hint of resolve. "Three days is enough time for me to make some arrangements." Mo Xiansheng watched him, a flicker of approval passing through his eyes. "This old man looks forward to watching your next performance." As the words fell, the remnant soul transformed into scattered ghostly lights, slowly dissipating into the night.

The night wind blew past, carrying the unique chill of the Rear Mountain. Chen Ji stood alone in the Forbidden Grounds, the jade slip tightly clutched in his hand. The fragment of the Tianji Record trembled slightly in the depths of his Mental Sea, as if sensing something. The ability to foresee the next three hours flickered occasionally, yet always vaguely pointed in one direction—the direction where Chen Nian, his sister who had been missing for years, was located. "The imperial court..." he murmured, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes. "You want the Tianji Record? Then come. This time, I will no longer be a chess piece that passively takes blows." The corner of his lips slightly lifted, forming a dangerous yet confident arc. This chess game had just begun to enter its exciting phase.
